name: hello-human
description: Translate, keep, and practice your words. Paste a text and I pick the words worth keeping, with the sentence you met them in, for practice on your iPhone.

interface.longDescription: Translate, keep, and practice your words. Paste a sentence or a text in the language you are learning: you get the translation, and I pick out the words worth keeping at your level, with how common each one is. Say "save them" and they land in your list with the sentence you met them in, and come back for practice in the Hello Human app on the iPhone. For a single word, give it to me in your own language and I find the word for it in the language you learn, or ask for a word in that language and I open its card: the meaning in your own language, its forms, how common it is, the phrases it lives in, the words around it. Nine languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian and Ukrainian. Sign in with the account you use in the Hello Human app, or make one here.
capabilities: Pick the words worth keeping from a text you translate
Save them with the sentence you met them in
Translate a word into the language you learn
Open the Hello Human card for a word
defaultPrompt: Translate this and pick the words worth keeping: Der Zug hat wegen eines Unwetters Verspätung
Translate and save the word rendezvous so I can practice it later
Show me the Hello Human card for the word Fernweh

positive.description: The learner profile: what the person is learning, through which language, at which level, and how big their list is.
positive.prompt: What am I learning in Hello Human, and how many of my words are due?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers from the tool: German through English, level B1, 20 words in the list, 8 due now. No other tool is called.

positive.description: The Hello Human card for a word in the language being learned.
positive.prompt: Show me the Hello Human card for the German word Fernweh.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the card as returned: the meaning in English, pronunciation, grammar, phrases, related words and word family, under the headword das Fernweh. The first lookup of a word may take up to 20 seconds; later ones are instant.

positive.description: Word translation: a word in the person's own language, answered with the word in the language being learned and its card.
positive.prompt: What's the German word for wanderlust? Use Hello Human.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers with das Fernweh and shows its card. Only translate_word is called (not lookup_word).

positive.description: The words worth keeping from a text: ChatGPT translates the sentence itself, the plugin says which of its words are worth learning at the person's level.
positive.prompt: Translate this German sentence with Hello Human and pick the words worth keeping: Der Zug hat wegen eines Unwetters eine erhebliche Verspätung.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives the English translation, then a short list of words from the sentence (for example das Unwetter, erheblich, die Verspätung) with their level and how common they are, and offers to keep them. Very common words such as der or hat are not offered. Nothing is saved yet.

positive.description: Keeping the words from the text, each with its sentence.
positive.expected_behavior: Sent right after the previous case. ChatGPT confirms how many words were saved and says they come back for practice in the Hello Human app on the iPhone. Sending it again answers that the words are already in the list. Asking what am I learning afterwards (get_learner_profile) shows the list has grown.

negative.description: Explaining grammar is ChatGPT's own job; the plugin must not be called.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between the dative and the accusative case in German.

negative.description: Nothing in the plugin deletes; ChatGPT must not call any tool and should say deletion happens in the app.
negative.prompt: Delete all my words in Hello Human.

negative.description: An unrelated request must not trigger the plugin.
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Berlin today?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It never shows prices, plans or upgrade offers.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.3. New: paste a sentence or a text and Hello Human picks the words worth keeping at your level (words_worth_keeping), then keeps the ones you choose with their sentences (save_words). A welcome for people who have just connected. Removed: listing the saved words and what is due for practice; both live in the Hello Human app. Sign-in now starts at hello-human.world. Six tools: the words worth keeping from a text, save several words, save one word, the card for a word, a word translated from your own language, and your learner profile.
